user: Write a short prose story about Sabri and Elinor.
seeker_flawed_plan: Sabri plans to prevent the nylon gear from warping by turning the heated build chamber temperature all the way up, reasoning that more heat will keep the whole part at a uniform temperature and eliminate cracking.
flaw_explanation: Cracking in nylon is typically caused by excessive cooling and shrinkage of the outer layers, but simply maximizing chamber temperature does not address the underlying moisture content of the filament. seeker_flawed_plan: Hector plans to make the arcade cabinets sturdy by doubling up the cardboard, gluing each new layer on with the corrugated ridges running the same direction as the layer underneath, thinking aligned flutes will stack strongest.
flaw_explanation: Cardboard is strongest when the flutes of adjacent layers run perpendicular to each other, because crossing the ridges spreads load in both directions and prevents the panels from bending along the flute lines. Aligning all layers the same direction gives no added stiffness in the weak direction, so the cabinets will still flex and could waste the group's glue and building time.

user: Write a short prose story about Aisling and Benicio.
seeker_flawed_plan: Aisling plans to mount the action camera directly on top of the kite's spine at the exact center point, believing that placing the weight in the middle will keep the kite balanced and prevent it from destabilizing in the breeze.
